evidence.reason: After edit calls reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0, "benchmark") instead of (minutes, 0.1, "work"), and contains a typo 'return valu' that is not a valid identifier.
After edit swaps priorities to [multiplier/2, multiplier], so priorities[0] changes from multiplier to multiplier/2, altering the floor term for every caller including evaluate.
Test asserts evaluate(20, 0.1, "work") > 0, which relies on reminderDelay's original priority ordering and on evaluate forwarding the multiplier unchanged.
Test asserts scheduledDelay(40) > 0, which relies on scheduledDelay passing a positive multiplier and valid calendar to evaluate; the left edit passes 0 and "benchmark".

result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/scheduling.ts#scheduledDelay：恢复调用 reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "work") 并修正 'return valu' 为 'return value'；同时确认 src/reminders.ts#reminderDelay 的 priorities 顺序是否应保持 [multiplier, multiplier/2]。
